temperature_matching.rule: one index is computed from one (T, eps, n, rho) tuple; inputs must share T within the tolerance, no cross-T splicing

molar_volume.formula: V_m = M / rho with M in g/mol and rho in kg/m^3 -> V_m in cm^3/mol

formula_mw_crosscheck.note: where both a CORE239 descriptor mass and a ThermoML formula mass exist they are compared; the formula mass is used only when the descriptor mass is absent

molar_volume.consequence: before this fallback the 67 NEW_MOLECULE_VALIDATED molecules had a measured density but no M, so V_m -- and therefore molar refraction, CED and H-bond site density -- was blank

formulas.dielectric_T_coefficient: OLS slope of eps vs T (>=3 points)

dft_polarizability_validation.what: Lorentz-Lorenz polarizability from measured n_D and V_m, compared with the r2SCAN-3c isotropic alpha
dft_polarizability_validation.interpretation: a high r means the DFT polarizability is consistent with the optical response; a systematic offset means the two definitions differ (gas-phase vs condensed)

caveats: CORRECTION: the local ThermoML corpus contains ZERO enthalpy-of-vaporisation records (see thermoml_coverage.json, 'enthalpy_of_vaporization': 0). CED and the Hildebrand parameter are therefore NOT_TESTABLE from this data, not 'computed on a small subset' -- an earlier wording of this caveat said 'sparse', which understated the gap
Lorentz-Lorenz uses n_D at the sodium D line; comparing it with a STATIC DFT polarizability assumes the optical and static electronic responses coincide, which is an approximation, not an identity
3-4 pi N_A conversion is the SI form; the 1e24 factor converts cm^3 to A^3

for the new molecules the molar mass comes from the ThermoML formula string, not from an optimised structure; multi-component or charged formulas are refused rather than summed, so a missing V_m here means 'mass not established', not 'density absent'
